title: Super Fast: Tomato and Pesto Fettuccine
subtitle: No chop, less prep, fuss free!
description: We’re big on making your life easier and that includes dreaming up recipes where you don’t even need a knife for prep. And they’re far from ho-hum because that’s just not how we roll. We like in-your-face flavours and we reckon you do, too, so this brilliant 'plus' pasta dish uses fresh egg fettuccine, basil pesto, cherry tomatoes, spinach, peas and feta. Yum, yum and yum.

steps.text: Toast almonds: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Put the almonds in a cold medium deep frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan.

Simmer sauce: Heat a generous drizzle of olive oil in the same pan over medium-high heat. Add 3 tsp pepper and garlic seasoning and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant. Add the tomatoes, a pinch of sugar and ½ tsp balsamic vinegar and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins to develop the flavour.

Cook peas and pasta: Meanwhile, add the peas and three-quarters of the pasta to the pan of boiling water. Cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until al dente. Reserve 1½ tbs cooking water, then drain the pasta and peas.

Finish pasta: Add the pasta and peas and spinach to the tomato mixture. Add the reserved cooking water, stirring constantly, until the sauce coats the pasta and looks slightly glossy. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt.
Serve up: Divide the pasta among bowls, spoon over the pesto, crumble over the feta and scatter with the almonds. Enjoy!
Make it yours: If you like a kick of heat, scatter over a pinch of chilli flakes or thinly sliced fresh chilli just before serving.
